# Aurora Research Compact

Fictional instrument among fictional polities. Signed at Port Meridian
on 2031-03-12 by 5 parties; in
force since 2032-06-01. Depositary: Council of Meridia.
Authentic texts: Meridian, Haldic, Common.

A fictional compact among fictional polities that sets a shared research
station aside for peaceful study and open data. It entered into force when
the last of its five original signatories deposited its ratification, per
[article 7](../articles/article-07.md#summary). No real state,
institution, or treaty is described here.

## Articles

1. **Peaceful purposes.** The station is used for peaceful research only. Fictional.
2. **Freedom of research.** Every party may conduct research at the station and host observers.
3. **Open data.** Observations are published to all parties within one season of collection.
4. **Governance council.** A council of consultative parties meets yearly and adopts measures by consensus.
5. **Disputes.** Disputes are settled by negotiation or mediation among the parties concerned.
6. **Amendment.** The compact is amended only by unanimous agreement of the consultative parties.
7. **Entry into force and accession.** The compact enters into force when every original signatory has deposited
its ratification with the depositary; other polities may accede afterwards.
